Based on my research, I was **not able to locate a specific, publicly‑posted Molina medical policy governing total shoulder arthroplasty (CPT 23472)**. Molina's public "Molina Clinical Policy" (MCP) library (hosted at molinaclinicalpolicy.com and mirrored on the Mississippi provider site) contains a "Shoulder MRI" policy and a "Shoulder Arthroscopy Guidelines" policy (MCP‑404), but no MCP titled "Total Shoulder Arthroplasty," "Shoulder Replacement," or "Shoulder Arthroplasty." Notably, the Shoulder Arthroscopy MCP itself instructs reviewers to "see MCG criteria" for related shoulder procedures — indicating Molina relies on the proprietary, licensed MCG Care Guidelines (not InterQual, and not a Molina‑authored MCP) for shoulder arthroplasty medical‑necessity review. MCG's guideline content is copyrighted/licensed and is not published in full to the public, so I cannot quote its criteria from a source I actually retrieved.
